description: Arena rule variant: draft status effects layered on the real Quick Duel rules (engine/arena-rules.mjs). Every effect is a paper-world prop (laminate, scorch, ink, staples, red tape, stamps) rather than fantasy magic, and each keeps a generic alias. Nothing here is part of the printed rules or normal play; the Test Arena (#arena) plays real matches with it switched on so the effects can be judged in combat. Promoting an effect means moving it into content/dojo-game.json, a card that applies it, and a ruling.

timing.rounds: Counted at Honor: an effect that lasts 2 rounds is gone at the second Honor after it lands.
timing.ownTurns: Counted at the end of the affected fighter's own turn (Hide): 1 means 'until the end of its next turn', like Witness Protection.

effects.name: Scorch
effects.summary: At each Honor, lose 1 HP per stack; DEF, Guard and Armor do not help. Stacks to 3, lasts 2 rounds and refreshes when applied again. Scorch melts Laminate.

effects.name: Ink Blot
effects.summary: At each Honor, lose 1 HP per stack, then the ink fades by one stack (3 stacks cost 3 + 2 + 1 = 6 HP). Stacks to 4. A smudged fighter recovers 1 less HP from healing.

effects.name: Laminated
effects.summary: Sealed in a laminate pouch until the end of your next turn: you cannot declare Attacks or play Defense cards, and your Speed is 2 lower. The first Hit you take tears the pouch: +2 damage, and Laminate ends. When it ends you cannot be laminated again until after the next Honor.

effects.name: Stapled
effects.summary: Pinned in place. You are stapled to the zone you last attacked: if your last Attack was Low, every Attack you declare must be Low. Cards that cannot hit that zone cannot be played as Attacks. Lasts 2 rounds.

effects.name: Red Tape
effects.summary: Paperwork slows everything: Market purchases and learning a Combo cost 1 more Focus per stack. Stacks to 2, lasts 2 rounds.

effects.name: Denied
effects.summary: The next card you play on your turn (an Attack, Kata, Equipment or Consumable) is stamped DENIED: it goes to your discard pile and does nothing. The stamp is used up.

effects.name: Paper Cut
effects.summary: Bleed. The cut reopens every time you swing: each time you declare an Attack, lose 1 HP per cut. Up to 3 cuts, lasting 3 rounds. Standing still (not attacking) costs nothing.

effects.name: Wet Floor
effects.summary: Slippery footing for 2 rounds: Speed 2 lower and DEF 1 lower.

effects.name: Barrier
effects.summary: A filed folder of protection: each stack absorbs 1 damage from Hits (after DEF and Guard), and absorbed stacks are used up. Up to 5 stacks. Lasts until used up or the end of your next turn. Damage at Honor is not absorbed.

effects.name: Static Shock
effects.summary: Charged with static until the end of your next turn: the first card you play on your turn jolts you for 2 HP, and you cannot gain Tempo.

effects.name: Rush Order
effects.summary: A buff. Stamped RUSH for 2 rounds: +2 Speed, and draw 1 extra card at the start of each of your turns.

effects.name: Dog-Eared
effects.summary: Creased and soft for 2 rounds: Hits against you deal +1 damage per stack, and Defense cards you play give 1 less Guard per stack. Stacks to 2.

keywords.name: Reimburse
keywords.summary: A Weapon keyword. When one of your Attacks Hits for 2 or more, file a receipt: recover 1 HP, once per round, never above Max HP. Blocked, prevented and Armor-absorbed damage does not count.
